integrity: The theorem follows from a formal generating-product identity, exact finite subset-sum certificates and an infinite elementary interval induction. Finite verification does not replace the inductive proof.
scientific_limitations: Only partitions into positive cubes; the nonnegative generating-product formula and eventual positivity are established prior results; novelty concerns the exact 124 threshold and all 23 equality indices. Unindexed antecedents cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp strictness threshold for the cubic partition-parity bias
